title: 分流：10 mA 怎么分给几条支路
summary: 电流源灌进 10 mA，看它在 1 kΩ、3.3 kΩ（再加 2.2 kΩ）之间怎么分。板上有块电流表接错了，先看它闹出了什么事。
concepts: ammeter in parallel 电流表并联（错误）
description: 并联支路按电导分电流：电阻越小，分得越多。电源工作在恒流模式，所以加一条支路时总电流不变，变的是每条支路的份额和结点电压。

cards.title: 10 mA 去哪儿了？
text: 板上已经有：恒流模式的电源（`12 V`、限流 `0.01 A`），给并排的 **R1** `1 kΩ` 和 **R2** `3.3 kΩ` 供电。还有人把电流表 **AM1** 直接接在了结点 N 和 GND 之间。
**读 AM1**。再用万用表**测 N 对 GND 的电压**。
两个电阻都还插着。10 mA 里，它们分到了多少？

cards.title: 岔路口：路越宽，车越多
text: - 电流到了结点，会**同时**走每一条路，就像车到了岔路口：路越宽，走的车越多。
- 对支路来说，“宽”就是**电导** $G = 1/R$ 大。每条支路按比例分走总电流：
$$I_k = I\,\frac{G_k}{G_1 + G_2 + \dots}$$
- 电流表只有 0.1 Ω，$G = 10$ S；R1 只有 0.001 S。R1 分到 $10\text{ mA} × \frac{0.001}{10.0013} ≈ 1$ µA，几乎全被表抢走了。
![](fig:split)
- 现在自己预测真正的分法：按键松开时两条支路，按住时三条。第三条支路加进来，总电流会变吗？

cards.title: 把表串进支路
text: - **把 AM1 从 N–GND 上拿下来。** 电流表要**串联**：把某个电阻靠 N 的那只脚拔出来，电流表接在空出来的两点之间，**红表笔在 N 一侧**。判分时串联的电流表算一根导线。
- 加第三条支路：**SW1** 一侧接 N，另一侧接 **R3** `2.2 kΩ`，R3 的另一端接 GND。
- 先**松开** SW1、再**按住**，分别读每条支路。电路检查通过后填测量题。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **电流按电导分**：电阻最小的那条分得最多。两条支路时：$I_1 = I\,\frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}$。
- 电流源供电时，加一条支路不改变总电流，只是重新分份额，结点电压随之降低。
- 坑：把电流表接在结点和 GND 之间，它就是全电路最小的电阻。真实万用表的保险丝会烧掉。

caption.text: 电流源的 I 到了结点 N，分给每一条支路。彩色的 R3 支路只在按住 SW1 时接通。

i18n.en: The source's I reaches node N and is shared by every branch. The coloured R3 branch is connected only while SW1 is held.

en.title: Current division: how 10 mA shares out
en.summary: A current source pushes 10 mA into 1 kΩ and 3.3 kΩ (then 2.2 kΩ as well): see how it shares out. An ammeter on the board is wired wrong — first see what it does.
en.description: Parallel branches share a current in proportion to their conductance: the smaller the resistor, the bigger its share. The supply runs in CC mode, so adding a branch leaves the total unchanged; the shares and the node voltage change.
en.compare:
**Compare**:
- Two branches (button released): I1 = 10 × 3.3 / 4.3 ≈ **7.67 mA**, I2 = 10 × 1 / 4.3 ≈ **2.33 mA**; N = 10 mA × (1k ∥ 3.3k = 767 Ω) ≈ 7.67 V.
- Three branches (button held): G1 = 1 mS, G2 = 0.303 mS, G3 = 0.455 mS, ΣG = 1.758 mS; I1 ≈ **5.69 mA**, I2 ≈ **1.72 mA**, I3 ≈ **2.58 mA**, still 10 mA in total; N drops to 10 / 1.758 ≈ 5.69 V.

If a reading is almost zero or N is close to 0 V, check that no ammeter is left between N and GND.

measurements.ask: Button released: ammeter in series with R1, read I1
Button released: move the ammeter into R2's branch, read I2
measurements.explain: I2 = 10 × 1 / 4.3 ≈ 2.33 mA. The smaller R1 takes more.

measurements.ask: Button held: the current in R3's branch, I3

choices: The same as released, still 10 mA: a current source does not care about the load
Larger: one more path, so more current
Smaller: the more parallel branches, the less current
measurements.ask: With the button held, read I2 as well, add the three branches and compare with I1 + I2 when released. The total:
measurements.explain: The source's current is fixed; a new branch only changes the shares, and N drops from about 7.67 V to about 5.69 V. With a voltage source the total would grow instead.

hints: An ammeter between N and GND shorts the circuit. Take it off first; to read a branch, open that branch and put the ammeter in series.
The button straddles the trench: one side to N, the other to R3, and R3's far end back to GND.
tests: Two branches: 10 mA shared by conductance
Button pressed, third branch added: the three branches share 10 mA again, N drops

cards.title: Where did the 10 mA go?
text: The board already holds the CC supply (`12 V`, limit `0.01 A`) feeding **R1** `1 kΩ` and **R2** `3.3 kΩ` side by side. Someone also left the ammeter **AM1** straight across node N and GND.
**Read AM1**. Then **measure N to GND** with the multimeter.
The two resistors are still plugged in. How much of the 10 mA do they get?

cards.title: A fork in the road: the wider road gets more cars
text: - At a node the current takes **every** path at once, like cars at a fork. The wider the road, the more cars take it.
- For a branch, "wide" means a large **conductance** $G = 1/R$. Each branch gets its share of the total:
$$I_k = I\,\frac{G_k}{G_1 + G_2 + \dots}$$
- The ammeter is 0.1 Ω, so $G = 10$ S, against 0.001 S for R1. R1 gets $10\text{ mA} × \frac{0.001}{10.0013} ≈ 1$ µA. The meter takes nearly everything.
![](fig:split)
- Now predict the real split yourself: two branches with SW1 released, three with SW1 held. Does the total change when the third branch joins?

cards.title: Put the meter in a branch
text: - **Take AM1 off N–GND.** An ammeter goes **in series**: pull one lead of a resistor off N and put AM1 across the gap, **red lead on the N side**. The check counts a series ammeter as a wire.
- Add the third branch: **SW1** with one side on N, and **R3** `2.2 kΩ` from its other side to GND.
- Read each branch with SW1 **released**, then **held**. Once the check passes, fill in the questions.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Current divides by conductance**: the smallest resistor takes the biggest share. For two branches: $I_1 = I\,\frac{R_2}{R_1 + R_2}$.
- Fed by a current source, a new branch does not change the total. It only reshuffles the shares and lowers the node voltage.
- Pitfall: an ammeter across a node is the smallest resistor of all. A real meter would blow its fuse.

tests.name: 两条支路：按电导分 10 mA
按下按键，加上第三条支路：三条支路重新分 10 mA，N 点电压下降

measurements.ask: 按键松开：电流表串在 R1 支路里，读 I1
按键松开：把电流表换到 R2 支路，读 I2
按住按键：R3 支路的电流 I3

choices: 和松开时一样，还是 10 mA：电流源的电流不随负载变
变大了：多了一条路，电流就多了
变小了：并联的支路越多，电流越小
measurements.ask: 按住按键时再读一下 I2，把三条支路加起来，和松开时的 I1 + I2 比较。总电流：
measurements.explain: 电流源的电流固定，加一条支路只是改变“份额”，N 点电压从约 7.67 V 降到约 5.69 V。换成电压源，总电流就会变大。

hints: 电流表接在 N 和 GND 之间，等于把电路短路。先拿掉它；想测哪条支路，就把那条支路断开，再把电流表串进去。
按键横跨凹槽：一边接 N，另一边接 R3，R3 的另一端回 GND。
